summary: Explains how to obtain the protocol documents used in the DARPA research community. It gives an overview of the 1985 DDN Protocol Handbook and points to sources for related documents, such as those from the US Department of Defense, ISO and CCITT.

eli5.summary: It is a shopping guide that tells you where to find the rulebooks for how computers talk to each other, back when finding them was hard.

questions: where to get ddn protocol handbook
